177:95.en: 「I am $$ドクトリン$$.\nI declare your fate...!」

177:218.en: 「Immature younger brothers, you have no future...!」

177:257.en: 「I acknowledge your strength.\nBut you lack the qualification...!」

177:372.en: 「Monsters born of the flow of\n120 million years...!」

177:427.en: 「In the name of duty and obligation,\nI declare your destruction...!」

177:550.en: 「I won't let you disrupt the Supreme God's rebirth ritual...!」

177:587.en: 「You are not permitted to receive\nthe light of the $$黒い太陽#sol$$...!」

177:724.en: 「Precisely because you deny it,\nyou must be punished」

177:831.en: 「Guiding immature younger brothers is our mission too...!」

177:870.en: 「The one and only being\nwho mastered this universe's truth...!」

177:991.en: 「Your clinging to life...!\n$$ドクトリン$$ will sever it!」

177:1042.en: 「I cannot grant you\neven the light of the Moon...!」

177:1091.en: 「Insolent man! The sun is with us!」

177:1132.en: 「Is it futile to reason with a child...!」

177:1171.en: 「Machine doll bearing a sun within!\nYour existence is not permitted!」

177:1234.en: 「Even if you unite light and darkness,\nyou cannot win...!」

177:1285.en: 「$$異能生存体$$...!\nI'll clear that karma myself!」

177:1383.en: 「I'll destroy all products of the civilization of fire...!」

177:1461.en: 「Fire taken up to face the future...!\nBut that cannot be permitted!」

177:1526.en: 「One who goes from evolution to $$シンカ$$!\nI pass judgment on you!」

177:1577.en: 「You who reach $$シンカ$$ led by Gundam!\nYou must die!」

177:1632.en: 「Know that the bud of $$シンカ$$ in you\nis the cause of all calamity!」

177:1687.en: 「Destroying civilization with your hands\nis the atonement you can make!」

177:1746.en: 「Gaining the means to turn feelings\ninto power is forbidden!」

177:1797.en: 「Sinful one, heir to the beast's blood!」

177:1830.en: 「Sink back into beasts once more!\nThat is your fate!」

177:1924.en: 「The salvation of the whole universe\nwill be accomplished by our hands!」

177:1979.en: 「You who bring forth life's power!\nStop that song!」

177:2030.en: 「Your feelings are just the reflex\nactions of lowly life forms...!」

177:2126.en: 「Demon God of Light! Fall to despair!」

177:2200.en: 「Receive the retribution\nfor dabbling in $$ゲッター線$$!」

177:2251.en: 「What could beings who just earn\ntheir daily bread know of cosmic truth...!」

177:2316.en: 「Defier of God's will...! You are guilty!」

177:2355.en: 「To you who deny that king's power,\nthe path to $$シンカ$$ is closed!」

177:2412.en: 「You who kill your own kind\nare the farthest from $$シンカ$$!」

177:2469.en: 「You may not wield the power of feelings!」

177:2510.en: 「You are without sin! But you're mine!」

177:2549.en: 「The $$天翅$$s have already perished!\nPerish too, Mechanical Angel!」

177:2637.en: 「There is no future beyond the flames that felled $$バアル$$...!」

177:2678.en: 「You dare challenge us with such power...!」

177:2719.en: 「Power born of the civilization of fire...!\nI reduce your existence to nothing!」

177:2825.en: 「Even the destination of the wind is in my grasp...!」

177:2868.en: 「That vessel will never hold a soul...!」

177:2907.en: 「Beast strayed from the herd...!\nI shall guide you!」

177:2958.en: 「Is that ship refusing\nthe fate we have decreed?!」

177:3011.en: 「Bearer of the twelve keys!\nOffer that power to the $$黒い太陽#sol$$!」

177:3070.en: 「You did well to nurture the keys...!\nThat alone deserves praise!」

177:3135.en: 「The twelve keys gather at the $$黒い太陽#sol$$...!\nYes, now is the time of rebirth!」

177:3200.en: 「$$悲しみの乙女$$!\nI shall wipe away those tears!」

177:3292.en: 「$$揺れる天秤$$! I'll shatter your will!」

177:3329.en: 「$$いがみ合う双子$$! Come to me!」

177:3405.en: 「Atone for your sins with your body!」

177:3440.en: 「That's in the palm of my hand too!」

177:3545.en: 「Learn what comes of\nraising a hand against us!」

177:3637.en: 「You who defy fate, be swallowed\nby the fate we decree!」

177:3850.en: 「You may not move from that spot!」

177:3912.en: 「You resort to petty tricks...\nTypical of Earthlings.」

177:3963.en: 「So desperate to survive...?\nKnow that very thing is your sin!」

177:4016.en: 「You have spat at heaven itself.\nIn time, you will learn it.」

177:4206.en: 「Even this result is all your fate.」

177:4239.en: 「Do not ask the impossible, $$テンプティ$$.」

177:4349.en: 「What a futile struggle you put up.」

177:4378.en: 「Fools cannot break the will of God.」

177:4493.en: 「This $$プロディキウム$$\nis the will of God itself.」

177:4542.en: 「'Feeble' is the word that suits you.」

177:4581.en: 「Touching me is all you can manage.」

177:4614.en: 「Is that the attack that felled countless foes?」

177:4655.en: 「You do not understand what power is.」

177:4729.en: 「It was that one's will that shook.」

177:4764.en: 「So you touched this $$プロディキウム$$.」

177:4830.en: 「You do not know what a $$スフィア$$ is.」

177:4873.en: 「You have mastered nothing\nof $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

177:4969.en: 「The time has come to pass judgment!」

177:5060.en: 「You... now, at last, know your sin!」

177:5159.en: 「The one who judges you...!\nIs the one sent from heaven!」

177:5210.en: 「As expected,\nyou deserve to be called monsters!」

177:5259.en: 「Know that your power is your sin!」

177:5294.en: 「You wield power without grasping\nwhat truth is...!」

177:5349.en: 「No wonder you made it\nall the way into $$エス・テラン$$!」

177:5404.en: 「Your violence...!\nDo you mean to awaken my anger!」

177:5500.en: 「$$シンカ$$ is not for the power-only!」

177:5543.en: 「A power that fears not even gods...!\nYou are no different from beasts!」

177:5664.en: 「Your sin: aiming that power at us!」

177:5705.en: 「$$テンプティ$$,\nleave the anger to me...!」

177:5863.en: 「Foreign matter! Do you mean to warp\nthe order of the $$カオス・コスモス$$!?」

177:5926.en: 「It seems some mercy\nstill remained within me!」

177:5985.en: 「I now cast off all softness...!\nAll that awaits you is annihilation!」

177:6052.en: 「We are the $$御使い$$s...!\nNo defeat for God's will incarnate!」

177:6109.en: 「I admit it!\nIn power alone, you rival $$バアル$$!」

177:6262.en: 「Anger unseen in 100 million years\nis filling me!」

177:6362.en: 「That moonlight...!\nIt can stand against the $$黒い太陽#sol$$!?」

177:6413.en: 「That man...!\nHe holds the sun's radiance inside!?」

177:6464.en: 「Child or not,\nyou must know your own sin!」

177:6560.en: 「So this... is the power of love!?」

177:6593.en: 「$$異能生存体$$...!\nCarry the god-killer stain again!?」

177:6658.en: 「$$始原の特異点$$!\nYou still defy fate!?」

177:6746.en: 「$$ガンダム$$!\nLead Earthlings to the next stage!?」

177:6799.en: 「This one...!\nAlready walking the path of $$シンカ$$!?」

177:6887.en: 「Unbelievable...! The life force\nthis one wields is truly infinite!」

177:6948.en: 「Accursed wings...!\nDo they carry feelings to me!?」

177:7005.en: 「A light that kills even gods...!\nTruly a Demon God, as they say!」

177:7056.en: 「Warrior of the $$ゲッター線$$!\nYou are already beyond saving!」

177:7117.en: 「So this... is the power of what\nEarth calls a salaryman!?」

177:7172.en: 「This one...! Ignores God's will\nand fights me by their own will!?」

177:7231.en: 「You who reject the power of kings!\nWhat do you aim for!?」

177:7282.en: 「How many feelings is this one\ncarrying into battle!?」

177:7400.en: 「Mechanical Angel, mingling\nof waters...! That is forbidden!」

177:7515.en: 「Wisdom of fire! Why not give up!?」

177:7556.en: 「Spiral Man! Did you set\nthe wind's destination for us!?」

177:7658.en: 「This one too is swayed by Earth!?」

177:7699.en: 「The power of gathered feelings...!\nIt rejects fate!?」

177:7760.en: 「Why!? Do the Spheres hold more power\nthan we anticipated!?」

177:7825.en: 「This is the power...!\nIf all twelve are gathered...!」

177:7876.en: 「That power...! Offer the Spheres'\npower to the $$黒い太陽#sol$$!」

177:7972.en: 「Do you feel no pain,\n$$傷だらけの獅子$$!?」

177:8025.en: 「$$揺れる天秤$$! Why not give up!?」

177:8066.en: 「$$いがみ合う双子$$! I seek that power!」

177:8146.en: 「This must be some mistake...!\nThen I have no choice...!」

177:8195.en: 「Be in awe... I am $$怒りのドクトリン$$.」

177:8236.en: 「We serve the Supreme God, father and elder brother of all parallel worlds...」

177:8324.en: 「In short, the pinnacle of all living things... no, of all existence.」

177:8416.en: 「Hee hee... That kind of thing is thrilling!」

177:8457.en: 「How foolish they are...\nThey could just be judged quietly」

177:8506.en: 「$$テンプティ$$ is having a blast, though!」

177:8802.en: 「A place humans can never reach,\nno matter what...」

177:8946.en: 「Or rather,\nthey just suck at aiming, right?」

177:9154.en: 「I don't like that sort of thing...!」

177:9195.en: 「That's enough, $$ドクトリン$$!\nLet's crush these guys!」

177:9320.en: 「Don't say I didn't warn you...!\n$$ドクトリン$$'s really angry now!」
